name: agent-team-mcp
description: A reusable AI software development team built on MCP. 13 specialized agents (Project Manager, Backend, Frontend, QA, Security, DevOps, UX, and more) collaborate via shared SQLite state. Exposes 44 MCP tools across 12 domains. All discussions and decisions are stored in the database so agents get back up to speed immediately when re-loaded.
